description: This Java class implements a Liquibase custom change that migrates drug order frequency data from text-based values to coded concept IDs within the OpenMRS system. It defines procedures to fetch unique frequency values, convert them to concept IDs, and update the database accordingly.

classes.name: MigrateDrugOrderFrequencyToCodedOrderFrequencyChangeset
classes.description: A Liquibase custom task class that migrates drug order frequency data from textual to coded form in the database.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method that retrieves unique frequencies and performs migration.

methods.name: migrateFrequenciesToCodedValue
methods.description: Handles the batch updating of drug order records with coded frequency IDs.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles transaction rollback and exception wrapping upon encountering errors.

methods.name: getConfirmationMessage
methods.description: Returns a message indicating completion of the migration process.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation before running, returns null indicating no validation errors.
